Treat this as a conditional forecast of investor scrutiny following an actual cessation of AI capital spending by any named company.

Read 'the second' as promptly following disclosure, including the first ordinary investor discussion of the decision.
Read 'cannot stop' as an asserted practical pressure from investors. Investor questions alone would not prove literal inability or establish that this pressure caused continued spending.
